dedupe_keys.name: realsat a global dataset of reservoir and lake surface area variations

description: ReaLSAT, a global dataset of reservoir and lake surface area variations is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ankush Khandelwal et al. Lakes and reservoirs, as most humans experience and use them, are dynamic bodies of water, with surface extents that increase and decrease with seasonal precipitation patterns, long-term changes in climate, and human management decisions. Coverage: global; published in 2022. Formats: CSV, Shapefile. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
